mapper.select: /* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsInSendList : GOVCBR632(반입신고서) 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBR632' AS TYPE_CODE , A.IN_NO , A.BL_NO , A.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , '9' AS FUNCTION_CODE , REPLACE(A.CARRYIN_DATE, '-', '') + REPLACE(A.CARRYIN_TIME, ':', '') AS CARRYIN_DATE_TIME , LOCATION_PLACE , IN_CLASS , 'A' AS BUNHAL , CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , IN_APPROVAL_NO , XRAY_CHECK , CT , PKG_TYPE , ACCIDENT_CLASS , WT , ACCIDENT_WT , ACCIDENT_CT , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , A.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE A.IN_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY A.IN_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsOutSendList : GOVCBR6NB(반출신고서) 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBR6NB' AS TYPE_CODE /* 문서형태구분 */ , A.OUT_NO /* 반출번호(PK) */ , A.BL_NO /* BL번호 */ , A.LAST_POD_STATUS /* 신고일자(송신일시) */ , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO /* 신고번호(보세구역부호(8)+년도(02)+일련번호(08)) */ , '9' AS FUNCTION_CODE /* 전자문서기능(9: 원본, 35: 재전송) */ , REPLACE(A.CARRYOUT_DATE, '-', '') + REPLACE(A.CARRYOUT_TIME, ':', '') AS CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME /* 반출일시(CCYYMMDDHHMMSS) */ , A.OUT_CLASS /* 화물반출유형 */ , 'A' AS BUNHAL /* 분할반출구분(A: 전량, P: 분할, L: 최종) */ , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO /* 화물관리번호 */ , A.OUT_APPROVAL_NO /* 반출근거번호 */ , A.OUT_CT /* 총반출수량 */ , A.OUT_WT /* 반출중량 */ , A.REGISTER_USER_ID /* 내부 로그용 로그인 사용자ID */ , A.TIC_OUT_SCAN_YN /* TIC이고반출SCAN여부 */ , B.OD_JOB_NO /* 작업내역 조회용 */ FROM TB_BMS_OUT A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO WHERE OUT_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY OUT_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsOutNoticeSendList : GOVCBR5II(목록보고서) 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBR5II' AS TYPE_CODE /* 문서형태구분 */ , A.OUT_NOTICE_NO /* 반출통고번호(PK) */ , A.BL_NO /* BL번호 */ , A.LAST_POD_STATUS /* 신고일자(송신일시) */ , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) + (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS OFFICE_ID , '9' AS FUNCTION_CODE /* 전자문서기능(9: 원본, 35: 재전송) */ , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO /* 화물관리번호 */ , REPLACE(A.OUT_NOTICE_DATE, '-', '') AS OUT_NOTICE_DATE /* 반출통고일자(CCYYMMDD) */ , A.NOTICE_CT /* 수량 */ , A.NOTICE_WT /* 중량 */ , REPLACE(A.PERIOD_OVER_DATE, '-', '') AS PERIOD_OVER_DATE /* 체화일자(CCYYMMDD) */ , A.BL_NO /* BL번호 */ , (SELECT BMS_WH_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS BMS_WH_CODE /* 보세구역번호 */ , A.CUSTOMER_NAME /* 화주명 */ , A.CUSTOMER_ZIPCODE /* 화주우편번호 */ , A.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 /* 화주기본주소 */ , A.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 /* 화주상세주소 */ , dbo.Cryptography(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.CUSTOMER_TEL, 1) /* 화주전화번호 */ , A.REGISTER_USER_ID /* 내부 로그용 로그인 사용자ID */ , B.OD_JOB_NO /* 작업내역 조회용 */ FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO WHERE A.OUT_NOTICE_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY A.OUT_NOTICE_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectCarryInChangeList : GOVCBR5LC(반입신고정정신청서) 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBR5LC' AS TYPE_CODE /* 문서형태구분 */ , A.CHANGE_NO /* 반출입정정신청번호(PK) */ , A.LAST_POD_STATUS /* 신고일자(송신일시) */ , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO /* 반출입신고번호 */ , A.CHANGE_CLASS /* 정정구분(01: 항목정정, 03: 내역삭제) */ , REPLACE(A.CHANGE_DATE, '-', '') AS CHANGE_DATE /* 정정일자(CCYYMMDD) */ , A.CHANGE_COUNT /* 정정차수(001, 002) */ , A.CHANGE_REASON /* 정정사유 */ , A.CHANGE_EMPLOYEE_NAME /* 신청인 */ , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO /* 화물관리번호 */ , A.REGISTER_USER_ID /* 내부 로그용 로그인 사용자ID */ , A.INOUT_NO , B.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_BMS_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.INOUT_NO = B.IN_NO AND A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO = B.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO WHERE INOUT_CLASS = '5LC' AND CHANGE_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY CHANGE_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectCarryInChangeItemList : 반입정정신청 항목 조회 */ SELECT CHANGE_NO /* 반출입정정신청번호(PK) */ , CHANGE_CODE /* 항목정정구분*/ , CHANGE_BEFORE /* 정정전내용 */ , CHANGE_AFTER /* 정정후내용 */ FROM TB_BMS_CHANGE_ITEMS WHERE CHANGE_NO = #{changeNo} ORDER BY SEQ_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectCarryOutChangeList : GOVCBR5LD(반출신고정정신청서) 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBR5LD' AS TYPE_CODE /* 문서형태구분 */ , A.CHANGE_NO /* 반출입정정신청번호(PK) */ , A.LAST_POD_STATUS /* 신고일자(송신일시) */ , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO /* 반출입신고번호 */ , A.CHANGE_CLASS /* 정정구분(01: 항목정정, 03: 내역삭제) */ , REPLACE(A.CHANGE_DATE, '-', '') AS CHANGE_DATE /* 정정일자(CCYYMMDD) */ , A.CHANGE_COUNT /* 정정차수(001, 002) */ , A.CHANGE_REASON /* 정정사유 */ , A.CHANGE_EMPLOYEE_NAME /* 신청인 */ , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO /* 화물관리번호 */ , A.REGISTER_USER_ID /* 내부 로그용 로그인 사용자ID */ , A.INOUT_NO , B.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_BMS_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.INOUT_NO = B.IN_NO AND A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO = B.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO WHERE INOUT_CLASS = '5LD' AND CHANGE_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY CHANGE_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectCarryOutChangeItemList : 반출정정신청 항목 조회 */ SELECT CHANGE_NO /* 반출입정정신청번호(PK) */ , CHANGE_CODE /* 항목정정구분*/ , CHANGE_BEFORE /* 정정전내용 */ , CHANGE_AFTER /* 정정후내용 */ FROM TB_BMS_CHANGE_ITEMS WHERE CHANGE_NO = #{changeNo} ORDER BY SEQ_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsAbnormalSendList : GOVCBRDKO(특송화물 반입물품 이상보고서) MBL 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBRDKO' AS TYPE_CODE /* 문서형태구분 */ , A.ABN_NO /* 반입이상관리번호 */ , A.LAST_POD_STATUS /* 신고일자(송신일시) */ , REPLACE(A.ABN_REQ_DATE, '-', '') AS ABN_REQ_DATE /* 제출일자(YYYYMMDD) */ , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) + (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS OFFICE_ID , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO /* 반입이상제출번호 */ , '10' AS AIRSEA_GBN /* 해상/항공 전송구분 */ , A.MRN /* 적하목록관리번호(Manifest Reference Number) */ , A.MBL_NO /* MBL번호 */ , A.MSN /* Master BL 일련번호(Mater BL Sequence Number) */ , A.REGISTER_USER_ID /* 내부 로그용 로그인 사용자ID */ FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL A WHERE A.ABN_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY A.ABN_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsAbnormalHblSendList : GOVCBRDKO(특송화물 반입물품 이상보고서) HBL 목록 조회 */ SELECT ABN_NO /* 반입이상관리번호 */ , BL_NO /* BL번호 */ , HSN /* House BL 일련번호(House BL Sequence Number) */ , EX_WT /* 예정중량 */ , WT /* 반입중량 */ , ACCIDENT_WT /* 사고중량 */ , EX_CT /* 예정수량 */ , CT /* 반입수량 */ , ACCIDENT_CT /* 사고수량 */ , ACCIDENT_CLASS /* 사고구분 */ , REJECT_REASON /* 사유 */ FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_BL WHERE ABN_NO = #{abnNo} ORDER BY ABN_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsAbnormalCorrSendList : GOVCBRDKP(특송화물 반입물품 이상보고 정정신청서) 목록 조회 */ SELECT 'GOVCBRDKP' AS TYPE_CODE /* 문서형태구분 */ , A.ABN_CHANGE_NO /* 반입물품이상정정번호 */ , A.LAST_POD_STATUS /* 신고일자(송신일시) */ , A.CHANGE_COUNT /* 정정차수 */ , REPLACE(A.CHANGE_DATE, '-', '') AS CHANGE_DATE /* 정정일자 */ , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) + (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS OFFICE_ID , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO /* 반입이상제출번호 */ , '10' AS AIRSEA_GBN /* 해상/항공 전송구분 */ , A.CHANGE_REASON /* 정정사유 */ , A.MRN /* 적하목록관리번호(Manifest Reference Number) */ , A.MBL_NO /* MBL번호 */ , A.MSN /* Master BL 일련번호(Mater BL Sequence Number) */ , A.CHANGE_CLASS /* 정정구분 */ , A.REGISTER_USER_ID /* 내부 로그용 로그인 사용자ID */ FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_CHANGE A WHERE A.ABN_CHANGE_NO IN (#{item}) ORDER BY A.ABN_CHANGE_NO

/* EdiBmsSendMapper.selectEdiBmsAbnormalHblCorrSendList : GOVCBRDKP(특송화물 반입물품 이상보고 정정신청서) HBL 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.ABN_CHANGE_NO /* 반입물품이상정정번호 */ , A.BL_NO /* BL번호 */ , A.HSN /* House BL 일련번호(House BL Sequence Number) */ , A.CHANGE_CLASS /* 정정구분 */ , A.EX_WT /* 예정중량 */ , A.WT /* 반입중량 */ , A.ACCIDENT_WT /* 사고중량 */ , A.EX_CT /* 예정수량 */ , A.CT /* 반입수량 */ , A.ACCIDENT_CT /* 사고수량 */ , A.ACCIDENT_CLASS /* 사고구분 */ , A.REJECT_REASON /* 사유 */ FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_CHANGE_BL A WHERE A.ABN_CHANGE_NO = #{abnChangeNo} ORDER BY A.ABN_CHANGE_NO
